summary.zh-CN: 让长会话从截断的压缩摘要中恢复，并新增持续关注、会话目录可靠性与 Desktop 启动修复。
summary.en-US: Keeps long sessions moving after truncated compaction summaries, with continuous attention, session reliability, and Desktop startup fixes.

body.zh-CN: Agent 可以绑定持续刷新的 Context、订阅外部事件，并在会话时间线中接收可见事件卡片。
body.en-US: Agents can bind refreshing Context, subscribe to external events, and receive visible event cards in the session timeline.

body.zh-CN: 新增实验性的 nextclaw exec 命令与 Harness SDK，可从脚本启动 Agent、Session 和 Run。
body.en-US: The experimental nextclaw exec command and Harness SDK can start Agents, Sessions, and Runs from scripts.

body.zh-CN: 摘要输出被截断时，会优先保留可验证的关键内容、有限缩小输入重试，并在必要时保留近期原文继续会话。
body.en-US: When summary output is truncated, NextClaw preserves a verified essential prefix, retries with smaller input, and can retain recent source messages to keep the session moving.

body.zh-CN: 会话目录迁移到 SQLite，并支持从旧索引和 journal 恢复，减少刷新或并发运行后会话从列表消失的问题。
body.en-US: The session catalog moves to SQLite and can rebuild from legacy indexes and journals, reducing missing sessions after refreshes or concurrent runtime use.

body.zh-CN: 安装包包含匹配 Electron 的 SQLite 原生模块，并等待 NCP Agent 真正 ready 后再报告启动成功。
body.en-US: Installers include an Electron-compatible native SQLite module and report successful startup only after the NCP Agent is ready.

body.zh-CN: 旧会话目录会在使用时自动迁移，原始会话 journal 保留不变。
body.en-US: Legacy session catalogs migrate on use while original session journals remain unchanged.
